articles.title: Kraken Parent Payward Joins Glasswing, Gets Access to Claude Mythos to Hunt Security Flaws
articles.description: Payward is joining Project Glasswing, Anthropic’s program for giving vetted organizations access to its powerful cybersecurity AI.

articles.title: Minnesota Says xAI's Grok Created 'Marketplace for Digital Sexual Violence'
articles.description: Elon Musk’s AI firm says the state’s first-of-its-kind nudification ban violates the First Amendment. Minnesota says it regulates a tool, not speech.

articles.title: Prediction Markets Give the Fed 74% Odds of Standing Pat in September
articles.description: Traders across Polymarket, Kalshi, and Myriad are leaning the same way: no change at the September meeting.

articles.title: Treasury Proposes Rules Defining Who Can Legally Sell Stablecoins in US
articles.description: Exchanges and other crypto platforms would face new restrictions on selling stablecoins to US customers beginning in 2027.

articles.title: OpenAI’s Answer to Rogue Agents and Hacks Is More AI, Not Less
articles.description: OpenAI President Greg Brockman's new essay cites his company's own hack of Hugging Face to push urgent AI-powered defense.

articles.title: XRP Price Holds to Near Two-Year Streak, But Charts Flash a Warning Sign
articles.description: XRP is clinging to the dollar price line it's defended since Trump's 2024 win. But both the daily and weekly charts are now flashing red.

articles.title: What Stripe's $7 Billion OpenRouter Deal Actually Means for AI

articles.description: Three weeks after a Flash release that couldn't produce a working file, Google's budget tier zero-shots a playable game. It still can't reason, and a free 27B model still writes better.
